column3: Close to the Hebrew; “like the spring rain [that] waters the land” is rendered “Like the latter and former rain to the earth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your loyalty” is rendered “your faithfulness.”
Close to the Hebrew; the future verbs “I will cut … I will kill” are rendered as past, “I have hewn … I have slain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “tracked with blood” is rendered “defiled with blood.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wickedness” (a planned evil) is rendered “lewdness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he has appointed a harvest” is rendered “a harvest is appointed.”
